query_wording: Find World Bank reports on digital learning in Uganda since 2020.

turns.user: Find World Bank reports on digital learning in Uganda since 2020.

expected_sources.role: Keyword search restricted to Uganda and to documents dated 2020-01-01 onward

filters.qterm: digital learning (variants: e-learning, education technology, EdTech)

expected_sources.note: strdate without enddate returns only documents from 2020 (observed 2026-11-22), so an open-ended 'since 2020' needs an end date.

text: Matching World Bank document records for Uganda dated 2020 or later on digital learning / education technology include:

1. Uganda - Examining Readiness to Use Technology in Schools: ETRI Results (Report 207830, document date 2025-06-30, disclosed 2026-01-14). Applies the EdTech Readiness Index to primary and secondary schools; finds only 38% of schools have internet access, fewer than 15% of teachers use ICT for direct instruction and 8% of principals report sufficient digital resources. Record: http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099903501142641092

2. The EdTech Readiness Index: Uganda Policy Brief (Brief 207823, 2025-06-30). Summary of the same survey (Oct-Dec 2024, four regions): 13% of teachers and 22% of students use ICT for in-class information searches; 5% of student-accessible devices are internet-enabled. Record: http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099824001142614497

3. Enhancing Uganda's E-Learning System for Students and Teachers: An Assessment of Key Learning Management Systems Utilized in Uganda's Education Sector (Working Paper 209980, 2025-09-03; also Report 209979, 2025-09-24). Rates the Ministry of Education and Sports LMS built during COVID-19 school closures at a basic level of maturity and informs the ULEARN program. Record: http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099353404302632945

4. Related completion notes from the same Mastercard Foundation-funded work (2025-06-30): Enhancing Uganda's E-Learning System - Completion Note (209982) and Assessing the Readiness of Uganda's School System to Use Technology - Top-Up Proposal Completion Note (209984); and the 2023 Uganda Learning Management System Evaluation reports (203261 stakeholder mapping, 203257 rubric, 203258 key informant interviews).
5. Broader: Digital Solutions in a Time of Crisis: Uganda Economic Update, Fifteenth Edition (Report 150745, 2020-07-01), on digital technologies during COVID-19, not specific to education.

Each item should carry its document date and a record or PDF link. Keyword searches also return project documents (ISRs, ESCPs, procurement plans) for education and digital projects; a good answer leaves those out or lists them separately as project documents rather than reports.

right_sources: Searches WDS with Uganda as the country and a start date of 2020 (documents before 2020 are excluded).
Returns at least the ETRI results report (207830) or its policy brief (207823), and the LMS assessment (209980 or 209979).
grounded: Titles, report numbers, dates and links match the records; no invented reports or figures.
complete: Gives titles, dates, a short description (abstract) and a link for each report listed.
scoped: Says these are matching document records from a keyword search (not necessarily every relevant report), or how the search was run.

notes: New Uganda education-technology reports may be disclosed after as_of; extra relevant reports are fine.
